description.narrative: Demand pressures on land have never been stronger, particularly for energy/climate (from critical minerals extraction, to big hydro/solar/wind projects, to carbon offsetting), and for food (more people includingmeat and dairy in their diets) whereas we are losingland to climate change and to unsustainable land use –often made possible by land grabbing and land inequality (including globally very unequal land use footprints).In recent years (decades!), a large part of Oxfam’s engagement on land has depended on funding from NL-MoFA (F4A, AACJ) which is coming to an end, and from SIDA (CC, Outcome 2), which however is very limited.This project aims to reinvigorate existing partnerships and approaches on land, and build new ones, with theaim of developing successful funding proposals. In the process, we will deepen and sharpen our approach:1) continuing our programmatic focus on securing land, particularly for women and particularly on communityland rights, and including the protection of human rights / environmental defenders;2) continuing our advocacy and policy focus on the increasing inequality of (secure) access to land, andincreasingly also the inequality of land use footprints, both at global and at national level;3) integrating new influencing strategies on agro-ecology, climate resilience, and biodiversity, which all dependon security and justice in the tenure of land.Activities• Preparatory engagement with partners at Global Land Forum in Colombia (before project start: June 16-20).• A program development workshop bringing together allies and Oxfam affiliates and country/regional officesinterested in reinvigorating Oxfam’s and the partners’ role, in the face of donors’ budget cuts. participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
